"""Capture the actual four-check current-flake Nix gate with frozen Root inputs."""
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/josh/projects/klem');PREFIX=Path('/tmp/klem-literary-future-kko-combined-nix');OUT=Path(str(PREFIX)+'.json');LOG=Path(str(PREFIX)+'.log');assert not OUT.exists() and not LOG.exists()
sha=lambda raw:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
source=Path('/tmp/klem-literary-future-kko-combined-inventory-source.txt').read_text().strip();assert source.startswith('/nix/store/') and source.endswith('-source')
inputs={};source_files={}
for p in Path(source).rglob('*'):
 assert not p.is_symlink()
 if not p.is_file():continue
 name=str(p.relative_to(source));raw=p.read_bytes();assert (ROOT/name).read_bytes()==raw,name
 source_files[name]={'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':sha(raw)}
tracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z'],cwd=ROOT).decode().split('\0')[:-1]
for name in tracked:
 raw=(ROOT/name).read_bytes();inputs[name]={'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':sha(raw)}
assert set(source_files)<=set(inputs)
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip();index=sha(subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--stage','-z'],cwd=ROOT))
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=ROOT)
Path('/tmp/klem-literary-future-kko-combined-build').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
command=['nix','build','--impure','--offline','--file','/tmp/klem-literary-future-kko-combined-checks.nix','--option','build-dir','/tmp/klem-literary-future-kko-combined-build','--cores','4','--max-jobs','1','--no-link','--print-out-paths','-L','klem','web-assets','corpus-adapter','inventory-review']
producer=Path(__file__);r={'schema_version':1,'state':'running','started_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'pid':os.getpid(),'command':command,'head':head,'index_sha256':index,'snapshot_files':inputs,'inventory_source':source,'inventory_source_files':source_files,'evaluation_expression':Path('/tmp/klem-literary-future-kko-combined-checks.nix').read_text(),'producer':{'text':producer.read_text(),'sha256':sha(producer.read_bytes())},'scope':'Actual complete four-check current-flake gate evaluated directly to avoid an additional full Git-source cache copy. Main CLI/server, frontend and adapter package checks are the actual independent Nix outputs; the complete inventory derivation runs every wired audit/control. This gate does not close broader linguistic coverage, precision or independent contextual review.'}
def save():OUT.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
save();env=os.environ.copy();env['TMPDIR']='/tmp/klem-literary-future-kko-combined-build'
with LOG.open('xb') as stream:job=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
r.update(state='passed' if job.returncode==0 else 'failed',exit_code=job.returncode,finished_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),inputs_unchanged=all(sha((ROOT/n).read_bytes())==v['sha256'] for n,v in inputs.items()),head_unchanged=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()==head,index_unchanged=sha(subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--stage','-z'],cwd=ROOT))==index,log_sha256=sha(LOG.read_bytes()),outputs=[line for line in LOG.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('/nix/store/')])
save();print('Actual combined four-check Nix gate:',r['state'],'exit',job.returncode,'Root inputs frozen:',r['inputs_unchanged'],'HEAD/index:',r['head_unchanged'],r['index_unchanged'],flush=True)
assert r['inputs_unchanged'] and r['head_unchanged'] and r['index_unchanged']
if job.returncode==0:assert len(r['outputs'])==4
